title: GOOD 2026
tagline: The global community conference of users and developers of Open OnDemand
location: University of Utah, Salt Lake City
hero_image_alt: Attendees at a GOOD Contributor Jam
overview: GOOD 2026 brought the global Open OnDemand community to Salt Lake City for four days of talks, tutorials, birds-of-a-feather sessions, and hands-on work with the core team.

The conference opened with a Contributor Jam on March 9, followed by tutorials on the morning of March 10 and the main conference through March 12. Conference topics included AI and OOD, cloud integration, apps and the Appverse, OOD for education, client impacts, security and data privacy, customizations, and core development.
